answer: Witnessed delay lottery. Each new identity must solve a unique verifiable delay puzzle tied to a crystal seed from the prior block; the agent then waits out a knoll period of N blocks before earning, during which any reward is escrowed and slashed if the identity's declared quartz entropy collides with an existing one. Cloning costs full puzzle compute plus N blocks of idle escrow per identity, so each marginal clone is strictly negative-EV.
